mapper.sql: o.org_seq, o.org_id, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.parent_seq, o.manager_name, o.phone, o.address, o.sort_order, o.use_yn, o.created_by, o.created_at, o.updated_by, o.updated_at, p.org_id AS parent_org_id, p.org_name AS parent_org_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user u WHERE u.org_seq = o.org_seq) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org c WHERE c.parent_seq = o.org_seq) AS child_count

where.if: AND ( LOWER(o.org_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(o.org_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(o.manager_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org o LEFT JOIN tb_org p ON p.org_seq = o.parent_seq
SELECT FROM tb_org o LEFT JOIN tb_org p ON p.org_seq = o.parent_seq WHERE o.org_id = #{orgId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_org SET org_name = #{orgName}, org_type = #{orgType}, parent_seq = #{parentSeq}, manager_name = #{managerName}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE org_seq = #{orgSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE org_seq = #{orgSeq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE org_seq = #{orgSeq} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND status <> 'RETIRED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org WHERE parent_seq = #{orgSeq}

SELECT u.user_name FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_user_role ur ON ur.user_seq = u.user_seq JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq WHERE u.org_seq = #{orgSeq} AND u.status <> 'RETIRED' AND r.org_scope <> #{orgType} GROUP BY u.user_name ORDER BY u.user_name

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(org_seq, parent_seq, depth) AS ( SELECT org_seq, parent_seq, 1 FROM tb_org WHERE org_seq = #{orgSeq} UNION ALL SELECT o.org_seq, o.parent_seq, a.depth + 1 FROM tb_org o JOIN ancestors a ON o.org_seq = a.parent_seq WHERE a.depth < 20 ) SELECT org_seq FROM ancestors
